selection_rule: Audit every one of the frozen 40 A decision views; choose the first in frozen hash order with at least 64 native pixel-adjacency faces in the fixed P3 prism. No RGB/NCC/reference/performance selection.
revision_reason: v1 fixed image 668 has only three native depth pixels in the P3 prism and zero valid faces. Preserve that failed attempt; v2 explicitly changes the eligibility rule and reports all candidates.
parameter_basis: Declared preprocessing choices, not published author defaults; integer raster coordinates and camera-Z depth. Existing COLMAP replaces unpublished PSMNet stage. 64 faces is an engineering nontrivial-support gate, not a quality/currentness threshold.
